title: The Pennington | 4BR | Sleeps 12 | 7 min Broadway
description:
The Pennington is East Nashville's go-to group house —
4BR, 7 beds, sleeps 12. Bunk room, 2 balconies, backyard with a gas grill, massive living room, and kitchen!

7 min to Broadway, 14 min to Grand Ole Opry. Perfect for bachelorette/bachelor weekends, family trips, and everything in between. 

Attending a Nashville wedding? Your whole group stays together and keeps the celebration going.

Superhost · ⭐️ 4.97 ⭐️ · 136 reviews

The space
The Pennington is built for groups who want to actually enjoy being together. The living room anchors the whole house — a massive sectional, electric fireplace, 65" TV, record player, and local artwork throughout. It's the kind of room nobody wants to leave.

The kitchen and dining area are fully stocked and sized for group meals — island seating, full appliances, coffee station, and everything you need to cook for a crowd.

Two balconies overlook a fully lit backyard with string lights and a gas grill — your crew's evening headquarters. The bunk room sleeps 4 on its own, plus 2 kings and a queen across three additional bedrooms. Everyone gets a bed. Nobody's on a couch.

East Nashville is right outside your door — walkable to some of the best bars, restaurants, coffee shops, and live music in the city.

Guest access
You have the entire house — all 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, full kitchen, living and dining areas, backyard, patio, and both balconies. 

Self-check-in via keypad. 

Your group has full, private access from arrival to checkout.

Other things to note
CMA Fest (June 5-8): The Pennington is 7 minutes from downtown — perfect home base for festival groups.

Parking: 2 dedicated off-street spots + free street parking directly in front. No permits required.

A few things that make this place work for groups:

- Bunk room sleeps 4 adults comfortably on full-size beds
· Sound machines in every bedroom
· Charging stations in every bedroom
· Washer and dryer on site
· Wheelchair ramp available on request

Distance to key spots:
· Broadway — 7 min
· Grand Ole Opry — 14 min
· Nissan Stadium — 3 miles
· Ryman Auditorium — 3.6 miles
· Ascend Amphitheater — 3.2 miles
· BNA Airport — 15 min
